basic_details.short_information: Railway Recruitment Cell, Northern Railway (RRC NR), New Delhi, Delhi, has invited applications for 4651 posts in 6 roles under Advt No. RRC/NR/03/2026/Act Apprentice. The posts include Act Apprentice - Cluster Lucknow (LKO), Act Apprentice - Cluster Delhi (DLI), Act Apprentice - Cluster Firozpur (FZR), Act Apprentice - Cluster Moradabad (MB) and 2 more. The online application is open from 11 November 2026 to 11 December 2026.

Register with Name, Father's Name, Community, Category, Mobile no., Email ID and Date of Birth.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of training and stipend as per extant rules applicable. Selected candidate (or guardian if minor) must sign a Contract of Apprenticeship Training No right to absorption in Railway after training; employment not obligatory for either side No hostel accommodation; released on completion of training

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only, as part of the online application; cash, cheque, money order, IPO, DD and fee stamps not accepted. Last date to pay the fee: 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will RRC NR Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening and scrutiny of applications Merit list from average of 10th and ITI percentage marks with equal weightage Document Verification with medical certificate No written test or viva Merit from average of 10th and ITI percentage marks with equal weightage Tie: older candidate first, then the one who passed matriculation earlier Final merit list prepared cluster-wise, trade-wise and community-wise equal to number of slots Mismatch between marks entered online and original mark sheet at Document Verification leads to rejection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth (10th certificate or DOB certificate) 10th pass mark sheet and certificate Consolidated ITI mark sheet of all semesters / Provisional National Trade Certificate with marks National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT with mark sheet SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-SM certificate in prescribed format (annexure on www.rrcnr.org) Discharge or serving certificate for Ex-servicemen quota applicants

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Open the link "Engagement of Act Apprentice" ONLINE Application on the RRC website www.rrcnr.org. Register with Name, Father's Name, Community, Category, Mobile no., Email ID and Date of Birth. Get the login password on the given email ID and by SMS on the registered mobile number. Log in, fill the Application Form, pay the online fee (except exempted categories) and upload documents. Upload photograph, signature and thumb impression, each 10 to 50 KB in jpg format, and the certificates. Submit finally and print the application and fee payment slip for your record. Apply on or before 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Merit list expected to be displayed in February 2027 Training slots are provisional and may increase or decrease No change allowed in the application after final submission No TA/DA or accommodation for appearing in the process Document Verification place and time will be given on the E-Admit Card on the RRC website No request to change division or unit will be entertained

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026. Applications opened on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4651 vacancies: 1525 Act Apprentice - Cluster Lucknow (LKO), 1312 Act Apprentice - Cluster Delhi (DLI), 740 Act Apprentice - Cluster Firozpur (FZR), 63 Act Apprentice - Cluster Moradabad (MB), 979 Act Apprentice - Cluster Ambala (UMB), 32 Act Apprentice - Cluster Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Others: Rs. 100 (non-refundable). SC/ST/PwBD/Women: No fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age (as on 11 December 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years, Ex-Servicemen Up to additional 10 years to the extent of service rendered in Defence Forces plus 3 years, with minimum 6 months service at a stretch.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Lucknow (LKO), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Delhi (DLI), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Firozpur (FZR), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Moradabad (MB), As per extant rules applicable for Act Apprentice - Cluster Ambala (UMB).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th class (10+2 system) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised Board, and ITI in the relevant trade (NCVT/SCVT), passed by 06/11/2026. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must meet physical fitness standards under the Apprentices Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992. PwBD candidates must apply against slots notified for their type of disability. Application must be filled in English or Hindi. Only one application per candidate; multiple applications are all rejected.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose 10th or ITI result is awaited on 06/11/2026. Candidates debarred for life by RRB/RRC, or debarred for a period not yet completed. Ex-servicemen who already joined Govt. civil service after availing ex-servicemen status (for age relaxation).

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening and scrutiny of applications. Merit list from average of 10th and ITI percentage marks with equal weightage. Document Verification with medical certificate. No written test or viva.
